whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Fit Beast Gym,

I noticed your gym has exceptional 4.9★ reviews in South Shivpuri, Patna, but your current Netlify demo site could use a major mobile upgrade for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom high-conversion live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://fitbeast.netlify.app/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Fit Beast Gym, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym (Fit Beast Gym in South Shivpuri, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with your 4.9-star rating, mobile-first speed, and direct WhatsApp trial booking. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual gym photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
